about: S&S Power Switchgear Ltd is the listed holding company of an electrical-engineering group supplying high-voltage disconnectors and retrofit services through SSPSE, protection and control panels through Acrastyle UK, LV panels through APIL and automation systems for aluminium smelters through HART.
